notes: THE COMB: a honeycomb wall of 1,024 cells (ids 0..1023) left for humans. LaunchToken is the standard fixed-supply ERC-20 'The Comb' (COMB), 18 decimals, 1,000,000,000 tokens minted once to the factory, plain transfers only. CombWall (src/CombWall.sol) has no constructor parameters and no owner, admin, pause, upgrade or payable path: any wallet may claim exactly one empty cell with a 1-64 byte message (claim), rewrite its own message at most once every 24 hours (carve), and release its cell so it becomes claimable again (release). Views: cellOf, hasCell, ownerOf, messageOf, nextCarveAt, claimedCount, cells. Events: Claimed, Carved, Released. CombWall does not reference the token and holds no COMB; the pool pairs COMB with IMD at the launch policy's fee and the factory supplies the LP, MerkleDistributor and pool initialization guard.
